en: The Sutra on the Preparation of Medicines for Healing Illnesses by the Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara with a Thousand Hands and a Thousand Eyes,
translated by the Tripitaka Master Jñānagupta of Western India by Imperial Decree.
At that time, the Buddha addressed Ānanda, saying:
"This divine mantra of the Great Compassionate Heart Dhāraṇī, which has been spoken by the Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara, is vast, perfect, and unimpeded."
This is true and not false.
If there are those who, having made a certain aspiration,
wish to entreat the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Avalokiteśvara, [they shall have their wishes fulfilled].
Take *karpūra* incense and recite the mantra over it twenty-one times before burning it.
At that time, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva will surely arrive immediately; *karpūra* incense refers to *andhasaka* (安息香).
If there are people who are possessed by a *tiryag-yakṣa*,
one should take *mṛttikā* clay, burn it to ashes,
mix it with pure mud, and fashion the form of a *tiryag-yakṣa*.
Before the image of the Thousand-Eyed One,
take a blade of tempered steel and recite the mantra one hundred and eight times.
Cut it into one hundred and eight pieces, reciting his name each time;
he will be cured forever and the affliction shall never recur. This refers to the skull of a *mṛtaka-mārjāra*, that is, a cat.
If there are those who have been harmed by the poison of sorcery (*gūḍha-viṣa*),
take *karpūra* incense and mix it with *cukkuḷa* incense; taking equal parts of each,
combine them with one *dōna* of well-water and stir thoroughly.
Boil [the ingredients] until half a *sheng* remains; discard the dregs and take the decoction.
Before an image of the Thousand-Eyed One, recite the mantra one hundred times. The illness will immediately be cured. Regarding *kapūra* incense: this refers to camphor.
If there are people who have been stung by a malignant venomous snake or a scorpion,
one should take a small amount of powdered dried ginger, recite the mantra over it seven times, and apply it to the wound.
It shall be immediately healed.
If there are those who, being evil enemies, seek to harm one with malicious words,
one should take pure earth, or flour, or wax.
Assuming the form and appearance of that evil person,
one takes a blade of tempered steel before the image of the Thousand-Eyed One.
Recite the mantra one hundred and eight times;
for each recitation, cut once while pronouncing the person's name.
Having burned away one hundred and eight sections,
that person immediately rejoices, cultivates the body, and manifests a state of profound mutual affection and reverence;
such a person is without enmity.
If there are those who suffer from the degeneration of the visual essence,
or those who are clear-sighted yet blind to darkness,
or those with white halos, red films, or lack of luminosity;
Take one *harītakī* fruit, one *āmalaka* fruit, and one *vibhītaka* fruit;
crush each of these three individually, place them under oil, and strain while grinding.
At that time, one must maintain strict purity and protection.
Do not let a woman who has recently given birth or a dog see [the patient].
Recite the Buddha’s name while reciting it from the mouth.
Mix white honey or human breast milk and apply it as an ointment over the eyes.
The breast milk required for this person must be the breast milk of a male child;
if it is the breast milk of a female child,
once the medicine has been compounded, [it will fail].
Furthermore, one must recite the mantra one thousand and eight times before an image of the Thousand-Eyed One and apply it to the eyes.
When the seven days have passed,
remain in a deep inner room;
be careful regarding drafts, the chamber, the five pungent vegetables, and all impure things.
Immediately, the essence will return, becoming clear, pure, and radiantly bright.
If there are those who suffer from the disease of the yakṣa-demons, one should take [the flesh of] tigers,
leopards, jackals, wolves, and bears.
Recite the mantra twenty-one times;
it will be cured immediately upon being applied to the body.
The lion skin is the most superior.
If there are people who have been bitten by a snake,
one should take a lock of hair from the person who was bitten, recite the mantra over it twenty-one times, and bind it [to the person].
If it is applied to a sore, it heals immediately; "knots" (*saṃnāha*) refers to the wax-like secretions formed within the ear canals.
If there are those who suffer from malignant convulsions that enter the heart, causing them to faint and be on the verge of death—
Take one pill of peach resin;
its size is also like that of a peach fruit.
Mix it with one *sheng* of clear water and boil it down.
Take half a sheng of the medicine and recite the mantra over it seven times.
Drink it all at once and you will immediately recover.
Do not allow a woman to boil this medicine.
One must prepare it with pure protection.
Generally, if various medicines are prepared without human supervision, they will lack efficacy.
If there are those suffering from *pishiyi* (contagious wasting), *guqi* (demonic vapors), or *fulian* (chronic, lingering) diseases, [one should proceed as follows].
Take *kukkuṭa* incense,
recite the mantra over it twenty-one times,
and burn it to fumigate the nostrils.
Furthermore, take seven pills the size of rabbit droppings and swallow them while reciting a great mantra twenty-eight times; the illness will immediately be cured.
Be careful to abstain from alcohol, meat, the five pungent roots, and harsh speech.
Furthermore, take *manasīla* and mix it with white mustard seeds.
Seal the salt with the mantra twenty-one times and burn it beneath the patient's bed.
When he manifests as a disease-demon, the wall immediately cracks;
the demon flees backward, not daring to remain. *Manaśila* refers to realgar (*manaḥśilā*).
"White" signifies purity.
This is the "Seal of Salt Beauty.
If there are people suffering from unilateral paralysis (hemiplegia),
such that their ears and noses are obstructed and their hands and feet are impaired;
Take sesame oil and infuse it with agarwood;
recite the mantra twenty-one times over it.
Rubbing it upon the body will ensure that one is forever cured.
Furthermore, take pure cow ghee,
recite the mantra over it twenty-one times,
and rub it upon the body; this will effect a cure.
If there is a woman suffering from difficult labor,
take sesame oil and recite the mantra over it twenty-one times.
Rub it on the navel and the vulva of a woman in labor;
if one causes her to swallow it, delivery will be easy.
If there is a woman whose fetus dies within her womb, [rub it on her navel].
Take one large liang of apāmārga grass,
boil it with two sheng of water, strain to remove the dregs,
and take one sheng of the decoction.
Recite the mantra twenty-one times;
upon ingesting it, [the fetus] will emerge immediately without any pain.
If the fetal membrane does not come out, [recite the mantra again].
If one also takes this medicine, one will immediately recover; it is *apāmārga* grass, which is *gokṣura* grass.
If there are those who suddenly suffer from unbearable heart pain, [this shall be applied].
For those afflicted by the "corpse-possession" (shi-zhu) spirits, take one pill of *duru* incense that has formed like a nipple and recite the mantra twenty-one times.
Chew and swallow it in the mouth, regardless of the quantity;
this will cause the affliction to be vomited out, and the patient will immediately recover.

One should be careful regarding the five pungent vegetables, wine, meat, oily substances, and all impure things, as well as *duru* incense within the chamber—this refers to *kunduruka* (frankincense).
If there are persons who have suffered from severe burns or ulcers, [one should avoid these].
Take warm *gomaya* (cow dung), recite the mantra over it twenty-eight times, and apply it to the sore;
it will be healed immediately. *Gomaya* refers to the dung of a black cow.
If there are those who suffer from heart pain caused by the gnawing of intestinal worms,
take half a *śu* of *kruñcamatsya* (crab-fish) powder and recite the mantra over it twenty-one times.
Upon wearing it, the ailment is immediately cured.
For severe cases, one *sheng* [of the substance] is used;
the worms will then emerge like twisted cords, and the patient recovers. *Gurumañca* refers to the dung of a white horse.
If there are those who suffer from hemorrhoids or anal sores,
one should take the leaves of the water chestnut (*bisa*), pound them, and extract the juice.
Recite the mantra over it twenty-one times.
If one lies down at night with [the medicine] placed in the eyes, one will immediately recover.
If it is necessary to use the urine of a white stallion,
recite the mantra twenty-one times over it.
As for the aforementioned *kharoṭaka*, it refers to fresh donkey dung.
If there are those suffering from ailments within the abdomen,
one should take well-water and two grains of salt shaped into seals.
Recite the mantra twenty-one times.
If one consumes half a sheng [of the medicine], one will immediately recover.
If there are those who suffer from red eyes, [the same applies].
Furthermore, for those who have protruding flesh in the eye or those with cataracts,
one should take śamī leaves.
Pound the *chāli* to extract the juice;
recite the mantra over it seven times.
Soak one copper coin overnight; recite the mantra over it again seven times.
As for the *kṣemīya* leaf mentioned here, it refers to the leaf of the *gouqi* (Cotoneaster).
If there are those who suffer from fear at night and find no peace,
or who are terrified when entering or exiting and feel startled and afraid, [they should apply this remedy].
Make a cord from white thread.
Recite the mantra twenty-one times and tie twenty-one knots.
The fetters around one's neck will likely be removed immediately. Not only will fear be eliminated,
but merit will also arise, transgressions will be extinguished, and one's lifespan will be extended.
If anyone should encounter sudden calamities within their home,
they should take branches of the pomegranate tree and cut them into one thousand pieces,
coating both ends with ghee, curd, and honey.
Recite the mantra once for each incense stick and burn them until one thousand and eight repetitions are complete;
all calamities and afflictions will be entirely extinguished.
This must be performed before an image of the Thousand-Eyed One.
If one takes white kumuda root,
recites the mantra over it one hundred and eight times,
and ties it upon the right arm.
In all places where one hears debate, one will achieve victory.
If one takes śamī leaves,
or cuts branches into inch-long pieces with both ends intact, [one should proceed as follows].
Anoint [the wood] with pure cow ghee, white honey, and cow curds;
recite the mantra once for each piece and burn one thousand and eight segments,
performing this three times daily.
At that time, recite it one hundred times separately for each day.
When the seven days are complete, the mantra-master will personally realize penetrating wisdom.
If there is a practitioner who wishes to subdue various powerful spirits and deities, [they should proceed as follows].
Take *ariṣṭaka* purple [wood],
recite the mantra twenty-one times over it,
and burn it in a fire; furthermore, one must use clarified butter, curd, and honey.
One must perform this before an image of Avalokiteśvara; the *ariṣṭaka* is the purple wood *dhātrī* (myrobalan) seed.
If one takes one *liang* and two *zhu* of Vairocana...
Pour the liquid into a bottle and place it before an image of Mahākaruṇika;
recite the mantra one thousand and eight times.
Anointing the body and marking the forehead with this—
namely, *hulu-zhana* (the "laughter-blossom") ox bezoar— causes all devas, nāgas, ghosts, spirits, humans, and non-humans to rejoice.
If there are those whose bodies are bound by cangues, fetters, stocks, or shackles, [this shall liberate them].
Take white lead and recite the mantra one hundred and eight times;
then smear it upon the hand.
If one uses it to rub upon shackles, fetters, stocks, or manacles,
they will be spontaneously released.
If there are husband and wife whose discord is like water and fire, [it shall likewise bring them harmony].
Take a tail-feather from a mandarin duck.
Recite the mantra over it one thousand and eight times before an image of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva.
Wear it upon yourself.
They shall henceforth rejoice together for the rest of their lives and love and respect one another.
If there are those whose field crops or five kinds of fruits are being eaten by insects,
they should take pure ashes and sand.
Recite the mantra one thousand and eight times and scatter it around the four sides of the field;
the insects will retreat and disperse.
If there are various fruit trees, one should additionally recite the mantra over water one hundred and eight times,
or even up to one thousand and eight times,
and sprinkle it upon the trees.
Insects will not dare to eat or harm the fruit.
If there are people who encounter a ghost that has sealed their mouths with spittle and whose human appearance indicates they are about to die suddenly,
one should take fine powder of amber and jade.
Recite the mantra one hundred and eight times and have [the patient] drink it with wine.
Furthermore, take the strained juice of *kruñcāṇḍī*.
Recite the mantra twenty-one times and have it ingested.
Furthermore, regarding the construction of the *kṣetrapāla* (field-protector) on the forehead:
recite the mantra one hundred and eighteen times, and the ailment will be cured. As for *gulma*, it refers to the dung of a white horse.
If there are those whose bodies have been burned or scalded by hot water or broth,
take wood ash and mix it with water;
recite the mantra over it twenty-one times.
Apply it three times daily over the mud-pustules;
furthermore, recite the mantra over heated *gomaya* twenty-one times.
If applied to a sore, it will heal immediately.
If there are people who have consumed the poisonous venom of various animals,
causing their minds to be distressed and agitated such that they are on the verge of death;
Take one *sheng* of pure soil and boil it with three *sheng* of water until one *sheng* of decoction remains.
Recite the mantra twenty-one times and have [the patient] drink it; they will be cured immediately.
If there are those who suddenly develop various swellings or abscesses,
one should take the leaves of the mustard plant, pound them, and mix them with clear wine.
Recite the mantra twenty-one times over them.
For swellings on the upper body, [the patient] will recover immediately.
If there are those who have malignant swellings that have entered the abdomen and are about to die,
one should take cow dung (*gomaya*), burn it, and mix it with wine.
Recite the mantra twenty-one times and smear it upon the swelling;
furthermore, have the person drink it and they will immediately recover.
If there are those who suffer from severe nosebleeds and are on the verge of death, [apply this remedy].
Take fresh *péng-lái* (Asparagus cochinchinensis) and boil it with water; take the decoction.
Without regard to the quantity, recite the mantra twenty-one times.
Have [the patient] swallow it, and the fetus will remain alive.
If there are those who suffer from bloody diarrhea or blood in the stool,
take peach resin the size of a chicken egg,
recite the mantra over it twenty-one times, and have them swallow it; they will be cured immediately.
If there are those who suffer from chronic cough,
take one *śīrṣa* of peach kernels,
mix them with heated fire and molasses.
Recite the mantra one hundred and eight times and have the patient swallow it all at once;
even if three or four doses must be prepared, the illness will be cured.
If someone suffers from itching in the anal region,
one should take *nālikera* fruit, wrap it in grass,
and grind it into a fine powder while hot, mixed with sugar.
Recite the mantra one hundred and eight times.
Apply it to the orifice three times a day and the ailment will be cured. Regarding the "grass-wrapped *lāka* fruit," this refers to the seeds of the *mūlaka* (radish).
If there is anyone suffering from constipation, [apply this remedy].
Take two *sheng* of *huaizi* (butterfly pea seeds).
Boil them with four *sheng* of water until one *sheng* of decoction remains.
Recite the mantra twenty-one times and drink it; the [obstructed substance] will then be expelled.

If there is anyone suffering from urinary obstruction, one should take the excrement of a young calf, squeeze it to extract the juice, recite the mantra twenty-one times over it, and have the patient drink it;
they will be cured immediately. "Gomayī" refers to the dung of a young calf.
If there are those who suffer from urinary obstruction,
one should take fine dust from the beam of a room,
sift it, and mix three finger-breadths of it with clear water.
If one recites the mantra twenty-one times and ingests it,
the ailment will be cured. If there are those who frequently urinate, or who must rise [to void] at intervals of about one *dou*, [this shall be applied].
Take one *liang* of the root of *kālānusārī*,
boil it with three *sheng* of clear water,
and strain to obtain half a *sheng* of the decoction.
Recite the mantra twenty-one times,
or one hundred and eight times; if taken all at once,
the illness will be cured immediately.
If there is a woman who, while pregnant, suddenly falls ill,
one should take five sheng of small beans and three sheng of fermented soybeans,
boil them with one dou of clear water.
Take three sheng of the decoction.
Recite the mantra one hundred and eight times over it.
Divide it into two doses for administration.
Immediately the illness will be cured and she will give birth in peace and comfort.
If there is a woman suffering from a difficult labor with the fetus inverted, such that she is on the verge of death,
one should take one *sheng* of *penglai*.
Boil three sheng of water until one sheng of decoction remains.
Recite the mantra twenty-one times and have [the patient] drink it;
they will immediately recover and be free from illness.
If there is a child suffering from night crying and unable to sleep peacefully, write the character for "ghost" (鬼) beneath the child's eyes.
Recite the mantra twenty-one times and spit three times; the affliction will immediately be cured and stilled.
If a child develops various sores on the head,
take the gallbladder of a *gomaya* (cow) and burn it to powder, then mix it with pig fat.
Recite the mantra twenty-one times and apply it to the sore; the affliction will be cured immediately.
If there is a child suffering from a swollen tongue who cannot nurse, [apply it as well].
Take the juice from the eastern direction,
recite the mantra over it one hundred and eight times,
and apply it to the tongue; one will be healed immediately.
If there is a child who has sores in the mouth and cannot eat,
take the root of *huanglian* (Coptis),
pound it finely, and sift it through a sieve.
Mix this with human breast milk and recite the mantra twenty-one times;
apply it to the mouth sore and it will immediately heal.
At that time, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Avalokiteśvara addressed the great assembly, saying:
"If, after the Tathāgata has entered parinirvāṇa,
sentient beings in the final age commit evil deeds with their mouths."
All diseases should be immeasurable;
therefore, the methods for their treatment that I now teach are likewise so.
Whether it be a bhikṣu or a bhikṣuṇī...
If upāsakas and upāsikās,
as well as sons and daughters of good family,
are able to receive and uphold this therapeutic method for rescuing sentient beings from suffering, [they shall attain these benefits].
You should know that this is my emanation body;
because I rescue sentient beings with a heart of great compassion,
I shall certainly go to where they are.
By performing these various rites, they shall achieve superior efficacy.
This person, by upholding this wondrous dhāraṇī phrase of the "Dhāraṇī of the Great Compassionate Heart that Grants Sovereignty According to One's Will," is able to rescue the world from suffering.
Such a person is no different from me; they are as my own body.
If there are sons or daughters of noble family with pure faith who are able to receive and uphold this *Dhāraṇī* for Deliverance from Suffering, [they shall likewise attain such merit].
The World-Sustainer’s method for removing obscurations:
although it cures all diseases,
it does so by means of a compassionate heart.
One must recite this mantra one hundred and eight times with a sincere mind;
by the power of Avalokiteśvara, there shall be nothing that does not come to pass.
If there are sentient beings who can uphold my Dharma, [they shall likewise attain success].
If that person is at the moment of death,
I shall swiftly come to meet them,
bringing the boundless vehicle of bliss upon a precious cloud-chariot.
They shall quickly attain rebirth in the Land of Ultimate Bliss,
where they will manifest through transformation from a lotus flower and achieve Buddhahood before long.
At that time, Śākyamuni Buddha praised Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, saying:
Excellent, excellent, Great Being!
It is so, it is so, just as you have said.
If there are good men or good women, and others like them, who...
By giving a portion of medicine to those who are ill,
one gains merit and extinguishes transgressions in the present life,
and the karmic reward will be inexhaustible in future lives.
In life after life, may they receive bodies free from illness and experience every form of happiness;
among gods and humans, may they enjoy all manner of excellence;
and among gods and humans, may their lifespans be immeasurable.
Not long after he had attained the Way,
the great assembly in the gathering— consisting of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas,
Brahmā, Śakra, the Four Heavenly Kings, devas, nāgas, yakṣas, various spirits, ghost kings, humans, non-humans, and so forth— [gathered there].
Having heard what the Buddha had spoken, they were all greatly rejoiced;
they received it with faith, prostrated themselves, dedicated the merit, and practiced accordingly.
*The Scripture on the Thousand-Handed and Thousand-Eyed Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva’s Compounding Medicines for Healing Illness*.
